text:
**Three of the 25 obligor groups are over their approved limit once subsidiaries are rolled up: Halvorsen Industrial Group, Brightwater Group and Corvane Partners.** In each case the parent company on its own is far below the limit. The excess sits in the subsidiaries, so a check of single client numbers (CIFs) would miss all three. Figures are as of 2026-09-30.

| Obligor group (ultimate parent) | Loan commitments (active) | Derivatives exposure | **Group exposure** | Approved limit | Over by | Utilization | Parent's own commitments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brightwater Group Inc (LE-10030) | $236.6M (21 facilities) | $0 | **$236.6M** | $200M | **+$36.6M** | **118.3%** | $1.6M |
| Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc (LE-10001) | $308.0M (10 facilities) | $36.3M | **$344.3M** | $300M | **+$44.3M** | **114.8%** | $40.0M |
| Corvane Partners Inc (LE-10052) | $171.2M (16 facilities) | $0 (3 trades, all marked negative) | **$171.2M** | $150M | **+$21.2M** | **114.1%** | $2.2M |

**Groups to watch closely:**
- **Halvorsen is the most urgent.** One rating agency cut it to CCC+ (negative outlook) on 2026-09-28. Under our rule, the lower of the two agency ratings maps to internal rating 8, Substandard.
  - Its $344.3M exposure is 95.6% of the $360M legal lending limit, leaving only $15.7M of room.
  - One guarantee counts as protection under our guarantee rules: Northcastle Mutual (A+) guarantees $30M of facility F0000008, which has a $45M commitment. Even after taking that $30M off, the group is at $314.3M, still over its limit (104.8%).
  - The parent and an in-group holding company also guarantee some facilities. Those don't reduce exposure because the guarantors are inside the group.
- **Brightwater and Corvane** both have a lower agency rating of B+, which maps to internal rating 6 (Pass). Every guarantee on their facilities comes from inside the group, so none reduces their exposure.
- **Under the lending-authority rules, any credit action on these three groups goes to the Senior Credit Committee.** Exposure above the group limit requires that, and for Halvorsen the Substandard rating alone would too.
- **The other 22 groups are within their limits.** Four are closest: Stellmark 91.5% ($164.7M of $180M), Ridgeport 90.1% ($108.1M of $120M), Marrowind 82.9% and Valewood 81.1%.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Group exposure:** commitments on active loan facilities in Snowflake (`BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY.COMMIT_AMT`, facility status ACTIVE) plus current derivatives exposure from Fabric (`dbo.CM_EXPOSURE.CURRENT_EXPOSURE`, 2026-09-30 snapshot only). Notional amounts and drawn balances are not counted.
- **Utilization:** group exposure divided by the approved group limit in Fabric (`dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT.LIMIT_AMT`, one limit per group). Above 1.0 means over limit.

question: Which obligor groups are over their approved credit limit once all their subsidiaries are rolled up?
answer:
**Three of the 25 obligor groups are over their approved limit once subsidiaries are rolled up: Halvorsen Industrial Group, Brightwater Group and Corvane Partners.** In each case the parent company on its own is far below the limit. The excess sits in the subsidiaries, so a check of single client numbers (CIFs) would miss all three. Figures are as of 2026-09-30.

| Obligor group (ultimate parent) | Loan commitments (active) | Derivatives exposure | **Group exposure** | Approved limit | Over by | Utilization | Parent's own commitments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brightwater Group Inc (LE-10030) | $236.6M (21 facilities) | $0 | **$236.6M** | $200M | **+$36.6M** | **118.3%** | $1.6M |
| Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc (LE-10001) | $308.0M (10 facilities) | $36.3M | **$344.3M** | $300M | **+$44.3M** | **114.8%** | $40.0M |
| Corvane Partners Inc (LE-10052) | $171.2M (16 facilities) | $0 (3 trades, all marked negative) | **$171.2M** | $150M | **+$21.2M** | **114.1%** | $2.2M |

**Groups to watch closely:**
- **Halvorsen is the most urgent.** One rating agency cut it to CCC+ (negative outlook) on 2026-09-28. Under our rule, the lower of the two agency ratings maps to internal rating 8, Substandard.
  - Its $344.3M exposure is 95.6% of the $360M legal lending limit, leaving only $15.7M of room.
  - One guarantee counts as protection under our guarantee rules: Northcastle Mutual (A+) guarantees $30M of facility F0000008, which has a $45M commitment. Even after taking that $30M off, the group is at $314.3M, still over its limit (104.8%).
  - The parent and an in-group holding company also guarantee some facilities. Those don't reduce exposure because the guarantors are inside the group.
- **Brightwater and Corvane** both have a lower agency rating of B+, which maps to internal rating 6 (Pass). Every guarantee on their facilities comes from inside the group, so none reduces their exposure.
- **Under the lending-authority rules, any credit action on these three groups goes to the Senior Credit Committee.** Exposure above the group limit requires that, and for Halvorsen the Substandard rating alone would too.
- **The other 22 groups are within their limits.** Four are closest: Stellmark 91.5% ($164.7M of $180M), Ridgeport 90.1% ($108.1M of $120M), Marrowind 82.9% and Valewood 81.1%.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Group exposure:** commitments on active loan facilities in Snowflake (`BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY.COMMIT_AMT`, facility status ACTIVE) plus current derivatives exposure from Fabric (`dbo.CM_EXPOSURE.CURRENT_EXPOSURE`, 2026-09-30 snapshot only). Notional amounts and drawn balances are not counted.
- **Utilization:** group exposure divided by the approved group limit in Fabric (`dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT.LIMIT_AMT`, one limit per group). Above 1.0 means over limit.
- **Group membership:** taken from the governed obligor-group reference list, built from the current ownership table (`dbo.OWNERSHIP`). Only current ownership links where the parent has control count, at any depth.
  - I re-checked the membership of the three breaching groups with the ownership trace.
  - Excluded as non-members: minority joint ventures (Halvorsen-Kito JV 40%, Brightwater Distribution LLC 23%, Corvane Properties 46%) and Halvorsen Marine Logistics, sold on 2025-11-30.
- **Business rules applied:** who counts as the customer (BR-CUST-01), exposure definition (BR-EXP-01), which guarantees count (BR-GUAR-01), rating mapping (BR-RATE-01), legal lending limit (BR-LLL-01, $360M) and lending authority (BR-DLA-01). I did not use the deprecated tables (`CPTY_HIER_LEGACY`, `CM_EXPOSURE_ARCHIVE`).

**Assumptions**
- The breach test uses gross exposure, as the ratified definition requires. The Halvorsen guarantee is shown only as extra context.
- Exposure of the excluded minority joint ventures and the sold entity is not counted. It would be reported separately as related exposure.
